basis: Urothelial carcinoma arising in the urinary bladder.
Neurodevelopmental embryopathy; micrognathia in 80-99% and zygomatic hypoplasia in 30-79%; hydronephrosis in 30-79%. Minor facial and ear appearances do not establish other organ damage.
Isolated inflammatory optic neuropathy; optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Brittle, sparse hair defines the syndrome; intellectual disability is a characteristic, commonly reported component, although its frequency is unspecified.
Syndromic intellectual disability with seizures and speech impairment; episodic central breathing dysregulation does not establish intrinsic pulmonary damage.
ADHD is a neurodevelopmental disorder, which is explicitly covered by the neurologic axis.
Nematode infection umbrella; tissue distribution varies, and no additional damaged organ is established in most patients across the group.
Benign blood vessel neoplasm within abdominal organs; the umbrella does not establish a specific visceral organ across cases.
Parasitic ocular infection supported by both parents and the child concept; 'epicondyles' in the definition conflicts with this consistent ocular classification.
Myeloproliferative neoplasm with malignant eosinophil proliferation; common damage to other organs is not established for this concept.
Inherited skin blistering; oral mucosal blisters in 3/3. Hearing loss, developmental delay and skeletal abnormalities each reported in 1/1 do not establish typical-course prevalence.
Early congenital infection; hepatitis, osteochondritis/periostitis and anemia commonly affect roughly ≥30% of symptomatic cases. Lasting neurologic injury is less consistently common.
Congenital bilateral accessory postaxial digits.
Inflammation of deep corneal tissue; the umbrella does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism in every case.
Phenylalanine metabolism disorder; untreated classic disease causes severe intellectual disability and neurologic dysfunction in nearly all patients.
Collagen/connective tissue disease umbrella with predominantly skeletal subtypes; specific extraorgan damage and immune mechanisms cannot be generalized across the group.
Congenital absence of one thyroid lobe. Usually asymptomatic per definition; broad hypothyroidism phenotypes do not establish common direct damage to other organs.
Purulent bacterial infection, usually occupying the pleural space; other cavity locations represent distinct subtypes.
Loss of ovarian endocrine function; gonads as hormone organs belong to metabolic_endocrine. Subsequent osteoporosis is a separate disease.
Placental obstetric disorder outside the axes; bleeding alone does not establish a blood-cell or coagulation disorder.
NDST1-related intellectual disability with developmental delay and frequent seizures; strabismus and pes planus each occur in 2/8, below 30%.
BK polyomavirus infection directly damages renal tissue; the hantavirus parent is inconsistent with the specific name and synonyms.
Chronic peripheral nerve dysfunction of unknown cause.
Infectious intestinal inflammation with bloody diarrhea; dehydration does not establish a separate damaged organ.
Benign fibroelastic connective tissue tumor typically arising in the deep infrascapular soft tissues of the locomotor system.
